text.characters: On 2 October 2023, the National Ageing Research Institute hosted the iSupport Cultural Adaptation Workshop, bringing together dementia carers, healthcare professionals, and researchers from Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, and Vietnam.

Facilitated by leading experts in dementia research from Australia and internationally, the workshop provided an opportunity to collaboratively discuss the cultural adaptation of iSupport — the World Health Organization’s online skills and training program for dementia carers (https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241515863).
A total of 26 participants contributed valuable insights and lived experiences to help ensure that iSupport is culturally appropriate, accessible, and relevant for diverse communities across the region. The workshop discussions highlighted the importance of culturally sensitive dementia support and the role of co-design in developing meaningful digital health solutions for carers.
We sincerely thank all participants and facilitators for their time, expertise, and contributions to this important initiative.
